title: Un sábado en Camden
setting: Emma te enseña Camden Market y te presenta a un vendedor amigo suyo.

says.t: This is my friend Sam. He has a stall here.
says.es: Este es mi amigo Sam. Tiene un puesto aquí.

options.t: Nice to meet you, Sam! What do you sell?
Nice to meet you, Sam! What does you sell?
options.feedback: Con you el ayudante es do: What do you sell?

says.t: Sam is shy! He sells old maps and postcards.
says.es: ¡Sam es tímido! Vende mapas y postales antiguos.

options.t: Lovely! Does he open every day?
Lovely! Does he opens every day?

options.feedback: En inglés la pregunta necesita does: Does he open…?

says.t: No, he doesn't. He works here at weekends. In the week he teaches history.
says.es: No. Trabaja aquí los fines de semana. Entre semana da clase de historia.

says.t: Yes! Look, this map is from 1890.

options.t: It's beautiful. How much is it?
It's beautiful. How many is it?
options.feedback: Para preguntar el precio: How much is it?

says.t: Twenty pounds. Sam says it's a present for you!
says.es: Veinte libras. ¡Sam dice que es un regalo para ti!

options.t: Oh, thank you so much, Sam!
Oh, thank you very much, Sam! I don't want pay.
options.es: ¡Ay, muchas gracias, Sam! No quiero pagar.
options.feedback: Con un regalo basta con dar las gracias. Y sería: I don't want to pay.

says.t: Now let's walk along the canal. Do you like boats?
says.es: Ahora vamos a pasear junto al canal. ¿Te gustan los barcos?

options.feedback: La respuesta corta es Yes, I do (o Yes, I like them).
